title: UW IRS Verification of Non-filing Letter Procedure

data.label: [DECISION] Choose Request Method
data.title: Choose Request Method
data.description: Request letter from IRS via Online, Telephone, or Paper form.
data.source_sentence: Non Tax filers can request an IRS Verification of Non-filing Letter, free of charge, from the IRS in one of three ways:

data.label: [ACTION] Submit Online Request
data.title: Submit Online Request
data.description: Access IRS Get Transcript Online tool.
data.source_sentence: Follow instructions for creating an account or log in.
documents: Account number for loan or credit card

data.label: [ACTION] Select Non-Filing Letter & Tax Year
data.title: Select Non-Filing Letter & Tax Year
data.description: Specify the requested tax year for verification.
data.source_sentence: Select “Verification of Non-filing Letter” and in the Tax Year field, enter the tax year we are requesting.

data.label: [DOCUMENT] Submit Letter to Financial Aid Office
data.title: Submit Letter to Financial Aid Office
data.description: Submit printed letter with student name and ID.
data.source_sentence: Submit the IRS Verification of Non-filing Letter, if requested, to the Office of Student Financial Aid; make sure to include the student’s name and UW student ID number on the letter.

data.label: [CONTACT] Request Letter by Telephone
data.title: Request Letter by Telephone
data.description: Call IRS automated phone service to order paper letter.
data.source_sentence: Available from the IRS by calling 1-800-908-9946.

deadline.text: within 5 to 10 days from the time of the request

data.label: [DOCUMENT] Download & Complete Form 4506-T
data.title: Download & Complete Form 4506-T
data.description: Download IRS Form 4506-T and complete lines 1 through 9.

data.label: [ACTION] Mail or Fax Form 4506-T
data.title: Mail or Fax Form 4506-T
data.description: Send completed form to the IRS processing address or fax.
data.source_sentence: Mail or fax the completed IRS Form 4506-T to the address (or FAX number) provided on page 2 of Form 4506-T.

data.label: ⚠️ [POLICY GAP] Procedure if student or parent filed a Puerto Rican or foreign income tax return
data.title: Policy Gap: Uncovered Procedure
data.description: Procedure if student or parent filed a Puerto Rican or foreign income tax return
data.callScript: Hello, my name is [Your Name]. I am following the university's UW IRS Verification of Non-filing Letter Procedure. At step "Choose Request Method", the published policy does not clarify: "Procedure if student or parent filed a Puerto Rican or foreign income tax return". Could I please speak with Office of Student Financial Aid to verify how I should proceed?

data.label: ⚠️ [POLICY GAP] Procedure if online identity verification fails or user has no mobile phone
data.title: Policy Gap: Uncovered Procedure
data.description: Procedure if online identity verification fails or user has no mobile phone
data.callScript: Hello, my name is [Your Name]. I am following the university's UW IRS Verification of Non-filing Letter Procedure. At step "Submit Online Request", the published policy does not clarify: "Procedure if online identity verification fails or user has no mobile phone".
